Context: Exception-

- GID (3), Rule 14.
14. To engage directly or indirectly in any trade or business, or hold an elective office in any body, whether incorporated or not, for a period of two terms or for a period of 5 years, whichever is earlier, when contesting an election in such body, as per existing rules, or canvass for a candidate for an elective office, in any body, or canvass in support of any business of insurance agency, commission agency, etc., owned or managed by any member of his family.
